subject.title: fix(feishu): refresh client after invalid token

question: Which Feishu invalid-token recovery branch should become canonical before this PR or its siblings merge?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same auth/message-delivery bug, and the proof-positive sibling is not cleanly mergeable, so automation should not close or merge around the branch choice.

options.title: Repair this PR first
options.body: Require this branch to clear the SDK tenant-token cache, fix the retry-budget edge, and add real Feishu recovery proof before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Adopt the proof-positive sibling after rebase
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97295 as canonical only after conflicts are resolved and current-main review remains clean.

options.title: Pause weaker duplicates
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97287 open and defer weaker sibling PRs until one clean canonical branch is ready.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR first
recommendation.body: Require this branch to clear the SDK tenant-token cache, fix the retry-budget edge, and add real Feishu recovery proof before reconsidering merge.
